??? quote "Dialogue"

    - Torvi Brask. From the high slopes, from the goats. Came down to see the city for a week, six years ago. Ha! The music was good. Still is.
    - You! The one who cleared the boardwalks. Did you eat the cheese? Outside? Good. In the highlands we would call you cousin for that.
    - Five hand-spans. I dream about those tracks. In the dream I am on the right side of the stream for once.
    - HA! There is the one who went down into the Wallow! I would hug you, but you would not survive it. City ribs.
    - She stood at the wall all afternoon and did not go. Ha. I have never been so proud of someone for doing nothing.
    - What is it?
        - *Choice:* Where are you from?
        - *Choice:* How is Zip doing?
        - *Choice:* How are the roads?
        - *Choice:* Nothing. Goodbye.
    - The Brask homestead. A stone shelter and goat pens on the far slopes, a long walk from anywhere. My grandmother Hulda put this axe in my hands. She split wood with it, cleared scrub, and once drove off a hill cat while holding a full pail of milk. Did not spill a drop. Ha!
    - In the highlands, anyone who comes to your fire in peace gets water, food and a bed. Here, I learned, you do not invite strangers in off the street, you queue for skewers, and you do not settle arguments by wrestling. Strange people. Good music.
    - Fast. She learns everything fast. Footwork in a month, guard in two. Everything except running. That one she fights like it owes her money. One day she will stand when she should run, and I will be too far away. I think about that.
    - She is learning the second day now. Walk away, come back when it is yours. It is the hardest thing I know, and she is learning it. Do not tell her I said she is good. She will dare me to something.
    - I guard caravans to Kaldemor, Selsior, the harbours. I charge fair and I never promise a safe road when there is not one. Fewer traders every year. A city that cannot trade stops dancing first. I came here for the dancing.
    - Ha! Go well. Come to the square tonight; Drum is playing.
